If this document enumerates platform libraries or dependency-direction rules, add libs/platform/context as a new platform library (nestjs-cls-backed runtime context infrastructure) with the dependency direction observability/security/database/queue -> platform/context -> nestjs-cls, and note that .dependency-cruiser.js now also enforces two platform/context-scoped rules in addition to the five libs/modules/*-scoped ones.
